method.description: Event study on daily closes. Reference = close before the first session able to react. Company-specific types are market-adjusted vs a benchmark; others are drift-adjusted. Major FX pairs use the Fed's 12:00 ET H.10 rates. Same-type events within 4 days are merged (their windows overlap). Best window = largest volatility-standardised (BMP) |t|. Confidence comes from a placebo test that re-runs the whole procedure on random dates; q-values control the false discovery rate across all rows.
